name: Peakhour.ai
author: peakhour

sections.description:
This plugin connects your WordPress site and WooCommerce store to Peakhour.ai (https://peakhour.ai), the AI marketing platform.

SEO Publisher
Peakhour.ai’s content engine creates SEO-optimised posts and pages and publishes them directly to your site — on schedule, automatically. Works with Yoast SEO, RankMath, and SEOPress.

Commerce Sync (requires WooCommerce)
Peakhour.ai learns your product catalogue, order patterns, and customer segments to power AI-generated marketing content that knows your store. This module activates automatically only when WooCommerce is installed and active.

A Peakhour.ai account is required. Start free at https://peakhour.ai.

External Services

This plugin connects to Peakhour.ai (https://peakhour.ai), a third-party AI marketing service.

Data transmitted (when connected and the relevant module is enabled):

  • Post and page content and SEO metadata (SEO Publisher module).
  • WooCommerce product, order, and customer data (Commerce Sync module, only when WooCommerce is active).
  • Site performance signals (daily).

This data is used solely to provide Peakhour.ai’s marketing services to you. It is never sold or shared with third parties.

  • Privacy Policy: https://peakhour.ai/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://peakhour.ai/terms
  • Data Processing Agreement: https://peakhour.ai/dpa
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/peakhour-ai, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → Peakhour.ai and enter your Peakhour.ai API key.
  4. Find your API key at https://peakhour.ai/settings/integrations/wordpress.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Peakhour.ai account?

Yes. The plugin is the bridge between your WordPress site and your Peakhour.ai account. Sign up free at https://peakhour.ai.

Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

Yes. The SEO Publisher module works on any WordPress site. Commerce Sync activates automatically only when WooCommerce is installed and active.

What data is sent to Peakhour.ai?

Post content, SEO metadata, and (if Commerce Sync is enabled) WooCommerce product and order data. See the External Services section above for full details.

Is my data secure?

All data is transmitted over HTTPS and your API key is encrypted at rest. See https://peakhour.ai/privacy for full details.
